# runpod_registry_delegation (Resource)

An AWS ECR pull delegation. The API has no update operation, so any change replaces the delegation.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "runpod_registry_delegation" "ecr" {
  name     = "ecr-trainers"
  resource = "arn:aws:ecr:us-east-1:123456789012:repository/trainers"
}

output "docker_registry_uri" {
  description = "Registry URI images resolve through once delegated."
  value       = runpod_registry_delegation.ecr.docker_registry_uri
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this resource live in the use-case
modules under `v2/modules/` in the provider repository; the Guides section
documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource` (String) ECR resource ARN to delegate pulls for. Not echoed by the API; tracked from configuration.

### Optional

- `name` (String) Human-readable delegation name.

### Read-Only

- `aws_region` (String) AWS region of the delegated ECR repository.
- `aws_user` (String) AWS principal Runpod pulls as; grant it read access on the repository.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC 3339 format.
- `docker_registry_uri` (String) Registry URI to pull the image from.
- `id` (String) Delegation identifier assigned by the API.
- `repository` (String) ECR repository name parsed from the delegated ARN.
- `tag` (String) Image tag the delegation covers.
